# Setloom

> Setloom is an open-source, keyboard-first harness for producing club tracks and DJ sets with an AI agent. The human directs in plain language and judges by ear; the agent composes, renders, inspects, and revises each track's editable source. No DAW or plug-in is operated by the user. Made by App Automaton, licensed AGPL-3.0-only.

Setloom is not a one-click music generator. Composition is not solved. What works today is a disciplined loop: the agent turns listening notes into concrete source changes, renders and inspects reproducibly, and keeps the workspace clean enough that the next pass continues without forensics.

## Canonical links

- Project site: https://appautomaton.com/setloom/
- Source repository: https://github.com/appautomaton/setloom
- Quick start: https://github.com/appautomaton/setloom#quick-start
- Maintainer: https://appautomaton.com/ and https://github.com/appautomaton

## Three roles

- The human is the listener and creative director: gives direction in plain language, judges the result, accepts or rejects.
- The agent is the producer: makes the musical choices within the brief, writes each track's code, renders an audition, inspects it, and revises rejected work.
- The harness is the studio: scaffolds tracks, renders, inspects audio, keeps the work reproducible, owns technical hygiene only, composes nothing.

## The loop

producer thesis -> per-track source edit -> render audition -> play and inspect (waveform, spectrum) -> human listening note -> revise or promote

## Toolkit (command line, Python)

- `setloom new`: scaffold a track (spec, runnable assembler, listening-notes template).
- `assemble.py`: each track's editable code assembles the music; renders are reproducible from source.
- `setloom play`: audition a render; nothing autoplays without the user's say.
- `setloom inspect`: waveform, spectrum, spectrogram, stereo field, and A/B comparisons.
- `setloom transcribe`: recover note candidates from reference audio with a native MLX Basic Pitch engine on Apple Silicon.
- `setloom anatomize`: dissect a reference by layers.
- `setloom.midi`, `setloom.audio`, `setloom.conductor`: MIDI, DSP hygiene, and music-theory primitives for track code.
- SuperCollider, Logic Pro, and Ableton Live can serve as agent-driven local production surfaces.

## Runtime

Python 3 through one repo-local `uv` environment. Transcription runs on Apple Silicon macOS via MLX. Model weights, audio, and proprietary samples stay out of Git.
